theme.description: System follows your OS appearance. Saved with your settings.

locale.description: Controls Reflect’s interface language. Your notes stay as you wrote them.

markdownSyntax.description: How literal markdown characters (**, `, etc.) are displayed while editing.

textSize.description: The reading size of the note editor.

fullWidth.description: Stretch note text across the window with a small edge margin.

spellCheck.description: Underline misspelled words while you type.

defaultBullet.description: New and empty notes open with a single bullet point, ready to type.

bulletAfterHeading.description: Pressing Return at the end of a heading starts a new bullet.

keyboard.description: Show every app and editor shortcut.

dateFormat.description: The style for dates shown throughout Reflect, including daily note titles.

weekStart.description: The first day shown in calendars.

timeFormat.description: How times are shown throughout Reflect — 8:22pm or 20:22.

templates.description: Markdown files in your graph's templates/ folder, inserted from the ⌘K palette.
templates.deleteDescription: “{{title}}” moves to the trash and can be recovered from there.

filterTags.description: Tags pinned as one-click filters at the top of the All Notes screen.
filterTags.empty: No pinned tags — the screen shows only the All tab and the Custom menu.
filterTags.invalidTag: "{{tag}}" can't be a tag — tags start with a letter and use letters, numbers, /, _ or -.

semantic.description: Find notes by meaning, not just keywords — smarter ⌘K results and related notes. Runs entirely on this device; enabling downloads a small model (~90 MB) once.

ocr.description: Make text in images and PDFs searchable. Private notes are skipped.
ocr.needProvider: Add an AI provider to enable this.
ocr.confirmDescription: Images and PDFs in non-private notes will be sent to your AI provider so their text can appear in search. Assets that already have OCR are skipped.

rebuild.description: Reflect keeps a local index of your notes to power search and links. If results ever look stale or incomplete, rebuild it — your notes are never changed.

aiProviders.empty: No AI providers configured. Add a provider API key to use AI features — keys are stored in your OS keychain and calls go directly to the provider.

dialog.title: Add AI provider
dialog.description: The API key is stored in your OS keychain, never in your graph.
dialog.modelSearchPlaceholder: Search or type a model name…
dialog.unverified: Couldn't reach {{provider}} to verify the key. Submit again to save it unverified.

aiPrompts.empty: No saved prompts. Select text in a note and press ⌘⇧J to run the built-in prompts; prompts you save here appear after them.

import.description: Choose the .zip export from Reflect V1. Its notes and attachments are added to this graph; nothing already here is replaced.
import.renamed: {{count}} renamed to avoid a name clash
import.failedAssets_one: {{count}} attachment couldn't be downloaded and still links to Reflect V1.
import.failedAssets_other: {{count}} attachments couldn't be downloaded and still link to Reflect V1.

updates.description: Reflect checks for new versions on launch and installs them only when you say so.

forget.description: Forget this graph. Files stay on disk.
forget.confirmDescription: Remove {{graphId}} from saved graphs. Files stay on disk.

delete.description: Move this graph and all of its notes to the trash.
delete.confirmDescription: Move {{graphId}} and all of its notes to the trash. Type {{graphName}} to confirm.

skill.description: Teach Claude Code and other agents to read “{{name}}” with the reflect CLI.
skill.conflict: A file Reflect doesn’t manage already exists there. Move it aside to install.

contacts.description: Suggest a contact's email and phone when a note's title matches their name.
contacts.deniedHint: to allow it, then return here.
contacts.notAsked: Reflect hasn’t asked for contacts access yet.

calendar.description: Show the day's meetings from Apple Calendar beside the daily note.
calendar.needPermission: Reflect needs permission to read your calendars.
calendar.cantRead: Reflect can’t read your calendars. Allow it under Privacy & Security → Calendars.
calendar.noneFound: No calendars found. Add accounts in System Settings → Internet Accounts.
calendar.chooseDescription: Select the calendars Reflect shows beside your daily note.

backup.descriptionGithub: Back up this graph to a GitHub repository. Edits back up automatically a few moments after you stop typing.
backup.descriptionRemote: This graph backs up to its own git remote. Edits back up automatically a few moments after you stop typing.

icloud.hosted: This graph lives in iCloud Drive — edits sync to your other devices, and conflicts resolve automatically where possible.
icloud.available: Copy this graph into iCloud Drive to sync it with your other devices.
icloud.unavailable: iCloud Drive isn’t reachable from this app — sign in to iCloud, or use a build with iCloud enabled.
icloud.oneDownloading: 1 note is still downloading from iCloud.
icloud.manyDownloading: {{count}} notes are still downloading from iCloud.
icloud.noGraphs: No graphs in iCloud Drive yet.
icloud.disconnectFail: The graph moved to iCloud, but GitHub backup could not be disconnected from the original folder: {{message}}
icloud.openFail: The copy landed in iCloud but could not be opened — open it from Saved graphs.
